purpose: Small timing-calibration benchmark of stage_a.py's REAL generation path (CTRStream, fixed_weight_support, ring_mul_sparse, decode_blocks), imported read-only and never modified. NOT the real-sampler defect-injection experiment itself. Claim tier: toy.
role: executor -- observations only; no interpretation, no status change
seed_note: Reuses stage_a.py's MASTER_SEED constant only as an input to sha_key's domain-separated derivation; the arm domain tag ('BENCH-TASK-77443e') and per-vector tags are benchmark-exclusive and share no domain string with any real (T)/NULL-M/NULL-P/CTRL-BS arm, so no benchmark draw is or could be reused as part of a measurement.

stage1_fixed_weight_support.note: 5 CTRStream-keyed fixed_weight_support calls per trial (weights: 2*omega + 2*omega_r + omega_e = 357 draws total)

stage2_ring_multiplication.note: support_to_int packing (x3) + 2 ring_mul_sparse shift-XOR accumulations per trial (omega+omega_r=141 shifts of an 17669-bit integer)

stage3_decode_blocks.note: one batched decode_blocks() call over all n_stage_trials, same real WHT/Reed-Muller decoder V2/V3 benchmarked

stages_summed.note: sum of stage1+stage2+bitpack+stage3, MY OWN separately-timed calls to the real functions -- compare against full_pipeline_via_real_t_shard below as a cross-check

full_pipeline_via_real_t_shard.note: calls stage_a.py's own unmodified _t_shard() worker directly (batch=64, replay/D5 disabled: want_replay=0). Includes D2 (exact-weight) and D3 (support-cap) invariant checking, i.e. this is the REAL per-trial cost stage_a.py itself would charge, not a reimplementation.
